Think of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model like a specialized traffic control center. Instead of one giant brain handling every single car, you have many small, specialized experts. When a specific type of traffic data arrives, only the relevant experts wake up to process it, while the rest stay asleep. This selective activation makes the system incredibly efficient.

For your laptop, this is a game-changer. Traditional models require massive power because they activate every parameter for every task. MoE allows the model to be huge in total size but tiny in active usage. You can store a massive library of knowledge on your chip, but only use a fraction of it at any given moment.
